begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 -- SCR 19442
 IF NVL(length(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id), 0) = 13 THEN
 :ctrl_blk_1.scheme_type := 'I';
 ELSE
 :ctrl_blk_1.scheme_type := 'C';
 END IF;
 ----
 :s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date is null

 end;
 begin
 select count('x') into :GLOBAL.x
 from unit_add_on_bags
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date and
 weld_flag is not null and

 (select 'x'
 from components
 where components.unit_id =

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_new_product_code varchar2(10); -- char(5);
 temp_new_desc VARCHAR2(256);
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 IF upper(:ctrl_blk_1.s_product_code) != 'M' THEN
 IF :scheme_type = 'I' then
 validate_product_scan_code128(:ctrl_blk_1.s_product_code,
 temp_new_product_code,
 temp_new_desc);
 IF not form_success THEN 
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_product_code := '';
 :ctrl_blk_1.product_code := '';
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 
 ELSIF :scheme_type = 'C' then
 validate_product_scan_codabar(UPPER(:ctrl_blk_1.s_product_code),
 temp_new_product_code,
 temp_new_desc);
 END IF;
 :ctrl_blk_1.product_code := temp_new_product_code;
 END IF;
END;
